data.title: Binance Margin Trading Adds BNB/ETH to Available Trading Pairs
data.body:
Fellow Binancians,

Binance’s Margin Trading platform has added BNB/ETH to its list of available trading pairs.

For a list of all supported assets and trading pairs for margin trading, please refer to: Margin Data.

Thanks for your support!

Binance Team

2019/11/07

 

Find us on 

Telegram: https://t.me/binanceexchange

Twitter: https://twitter.com/binance

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/binance 

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/binance
